flash.reason: Seeed documents the XIAO ESP32-C3 as a 4 MB flash board; confirm the attached board with flashing tooling during bring-up.

uf2.reason: The Zephyr ESP32-C3 build path currently produces ESP flashable binaries for this repository; no XIAO UF2 replacement flow is implemented.

wifi.reason: The XIAO ESP32-C3 uses the same ESP32-C3 radio class as the current Zephyr reference firmware. Hardware radio validation on this board is still required.

ble.reason: The upstream Zephyr XIAO ESP32-C3 board enables ESP32 Bluetooth HCI. SquidScript BLE object-transfer runtime completion and XIAO hardware validation remain separate work.

GPIO0.reason: Not part of the XIAO D0-D10 connector mapping documented by Zephyr for this board.

GPIO1.reason: Not part of the XIAO D0-D10 connector mapping documented by Zephyr for this board.

GPIO2.label: D0
GPIO2.reason: Seeed maps XIAO D0 to GPIO2 and warns that GPIO2 is an ESP32-C3 strapping pin. The e-paper reset line must not hold it in an invalid boot state.

GPIO3.label: D1
GPIO3.reason: Seeed maps XIAO D1 to GPIO3; the ePaper Driver Board uses it as e-paper chip select.

GPIO4.label: D2
GPIO4.reason: Seeed maps XIAO D2 to GPIO4; the ePaper Driver Board uses it as e-paper BUSY.

GPIO5.label: D3
GPIO5.reason: Seeed maps XIAO D3 to GPIO5; the ePaper Driver Board uses it as e-paper D/C.

GPIO6.label: D4
GPIO6.reason: Available through the XIAO ePaper Driver Board IO breakout. Planned SD chip-select candidate only; confirm jumper wiring before enabling runtime SD.

GPIO7.label: D5
GPIO7.reason: Available through the XIAO ePaper Driver Board IO breakout. Planned SD MISO candidate only; confirm jumper wiring before enabling runtime SD.

GPIO8.label: D8
GPIO8.reason: Seeed maps XIAO D8 to GPIO8 and warns that GPIO8 is an ESP32-C3 strapping pin. The shared SPI clock line must not be pulled into an invalid boot state.

GPIO9.label: D9
GPIO9.reason: Seeed maps XIAO D9 to GPIO9 and identifies it with BOOT behavior. This target avoids GPIO9 for default e-paper and SD wiring.

GPIO10.label: D10
GPIO10.reason: Seeed maps XIAO D10 to GPIO10; the ePaper Driver Board uses it as MOSI and the planned SD reader shares it.

GPIO18.reason: Native USB Serial/JTAG D- for the XIAO ESP32-C3.

GPIO19.reason: Native USB Serial/JTAG D+ for the XIAO ESP32-C3.

GPIO20.label: D7
GPIO20.reason: Zephyr maps UART0 RX to GPIO20; native USB serial is the preferred SquidScript console path.

GPIO21.label: D6
GPIO21.reason: Zephyr maps UART0 TX to GPIO21; native USB serial is the preferred SquidScript console path.

storage.sd.reason: The SD reader is an external breakout jumper-wired to the XIAO ePaper Driver Board IO breakout. SCK and MOSI share the e-paper SPI bus; MISO and CS must be filled in only after physical wiring is confirmed.

external.reason: The physical SD reader is part of the target plan but is not mounted or exposed to SquidScript until wiring, card-missing policy, and app/content storage behavior are implemented.

storage.reason: Installed apps and app state remain on the internal 192 KiB LittleFS app store for the first XIAO slice. SD app/content storage is tracked as follow-up work.

input.reason: The XIAO ePaper Driver Board target currently uses serial commands for SquidScript input during bring-up. No physical input is declared until a concrete button/input board is selected.

power.reason: The XIAO ESP32-C3 has battery charging hardware, but SquidScript target power policy remains USB/serial-first until battery measurement and wake input wiring are verified.

squidscript.reason: This target uses the same Zephyr SquidScript VM host as the Super Mini, with XIAO-specific target metadata and display bring-up diagnostics.
